name: Campo de Borja
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: Campo de Borja is a transition zone between the Ebro plains and the Iberian mountains, with its highest vineyards on the foothills of Moncayo. Garnacha Tinta, Syrah and Cabernet Sauvignon are among its allowed grapes.
